# On and off by default — the `nextjs` pack

Back to [what a fresh install turns on](../defaults.md) · [every rule of the pack](../README.md#nextjs).

- **Installed by `codelaw init` when:** `package.json` depends on `next`.
- **Rules:** 22 — 0 on, 22 on with `preview = true`, 0 off in an opt-in preset, 0 in no preset.

## Presets

| Preset | Written by `init` | Rules | Severities | What it is |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| `next/recommended` | yes, once the pack is installed | 22 | 8 error, 14 warn | @next/eslint-plugin-next 16.4.3's recommended — all 22 rules — reimplemented (W-139) |

## Rules
